data.name: GNC Engineer: Modeling and Simulation/Scrum Master – Level 2/3 (Chandler)
data.jobDescription:
RELOCATION ASSISTANCE: Relocation assistance may be available

CLEARANCE REQUIRED FOR START: No

CLEARANCE TYPE: None

TRAVEL: No

Description

At Northrop Grumman, our employees have incredible opportunities to work on revolutionary systems that impact people's lives around the world today, and for generations to come. Our pioneering and inventive spirit has enabled us to be at the forefront of many technological advancements in our nation's history - from the first flight across the Atlantic Ocean, to stealth bombers, to landing on the moon. We look for people who have bold new ideas, courage and a pioneering spirit to join forces to invent the future, and have fun along the way. Our culture thrives on intellectual curiosity, cognitive diversity and bringing your whole self to work — and we have an insatiable drive to do what others think is impossible. Our employees are not only part of history, they're making history.

If forging a secure future excites you, look no further! Northrop Grumman’s Space Sector provides an arena where your passion for innovation and quest for exploration are welcome. As a GNC Engineer/Scrum Master – Level 2 or Level 3 your role at Chandler, AZ will be pivotal in supporting missions critical to national and global security. This position is 100% onsite and cannot accommodate telecommute work.

Ready to join forces with our visionary team?   

Our GNC (Guidance, Navigation, and Control) Engineers design, develop, implement, verify and test algorithms and software and simulation tools to perform guidance, navigation and control of missiles, launch vehicles and upper stages powered and coast phases of launch, flight, earth orbit, interplanetary cruise and orbital insertion, as well as during staging events.

This position will work a 9/80 schedule, with every other Friday off.

Your mission, should you choose to accept:

  • In this role, you will be responsible for GNC modeling, simulation, and analysis, as well as Scrum Master duties, such as facilitating stand-ups, sprint planning, retrospectives, and improving Agile practices within the development lifecycle.
  • Design, develop, implement, verify, and test high‑quality software and simulation toolchains for flight systems.
  • Develop and integrate autopilot and guidance algorithms directly into flight software, collaborating with software and hardware teams.
  • Generate, analyze, and interpret vehicle trajectories using trajectory‑optimization tools.
  • Modify or create new scripts (e.g., Python, MATLAB, Bash) to capture customer requirements and evaluate vehicle performance.
  • Build, validate, and maintain accurate modeling and simulation frameworks for aerospace systems and components.
  • Enhance simulation fidelity by applying advanced modeling techniques to support analysis and decision‑making.
  • Conduct rigorous testing to identify and resolve discrepancies between simulation and real-world performance metrics.
  • Gather, process, and analyze large data sets to verify and validate system performance results.
  • Ensure simulation outputs align with system specifications and performance targets.
  • Other duties as assigned

If this job description reads like it was written specifically for you, consider joining our team!

This position is contingent upon the candidate obtaining final clearances and program access(es) within a reasonable period of time as determined by the company.

This position can be filled at either a Level 2 or Level 3.

Basic Qualifications for Level 2:

  • Bachelor’s degree with 2 years of professional experience – OR – Master’s degree with 0 years of professional experience.  Will consider an additional 4+ years of experience in lieu of degree.
  • Must have the ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. Government DoD Secret security clearance
  • Proficiency in object-oriented programming, especially C++, and scripting languages such as Python, MATLAB, and Bash.
  • Experience with simulation development and toolchains.
  • Strong background in Agile methodologies with experience as a Scrum Master or Agile Facilitator.
  • Familiarity with Scrum practices.

Basic Qualifications for Level 3:

  • Bachelor’s degree with 5 years of professional experience – OR – Master’s degree with 3 years of professional experience – OR – PhD with 1 year of professional experience.  Will consider an additional 4+ years of experience in lieu of degree.
  • Must have the ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. Government DoD Secret security clearance
  • Proficiency in object-oriented programming, especially C++, and scripting languages such as Python, MATLAB, and Bash.
  • Experience with simulation development and toolchains.
  • Strong background in Agile methodologies with experience as a Scrum Master or Agile Facilitator.
  • Familiarity with Scrum practices.

 Preferred Qualifications:  

  • Guidance, Navigation, and Control (GNC): Experience working with GNC algorithms and running 6DOF/3DOF simulations on HPC clusters to model vehicle trajectory and performance.
  • CI/CD Pipelines: Ability to create and automate simulation runs and post-processing workflows.
  • High-Performance Computing (HPC): Proficiency with job schedulers like SLURM or PBS.
  • Certifications: Agile Certification.
  • Security Clearance: Active DoD Secret security clearance.

Northrop Grumman Total Rewards
